## Summary

Describe the problem, the change and the affected component.

## Verification

- [ ] Applicable tests, lint and formatting checks pass.
- [ ] License and third-party notices are updated when needed.
- [ ] No secret, certificate, customer configuration, production namespace or operational data is included.
- [ ] GitHub Actions, Git dependencies and images use immutable pins.
- [ ] The change preserves Zero-Transcoding, identity, concurrency and MoQT invariants, or includes an accepted ADR.
- [ ] Every commit contains a DCO 1.1 `Signed-off-by` trailer.

## Licensing

- [ ] I am contributing under the existing license of the component modified: Apache-2.0 in `Teremoq/teremoq`, or MIT OR Apache-2.0 in `Teremoq/moq-rs-teremoq`.
- [ ] Third-party and generated material retains its original license and attribution.

## Security

Do not use a pull request to disclose a vulnerability. Follow `SECURITY.md` and
use GitHub Private Vulnerability Reporting.
